title: Return Timing Figures for the Keyturn Trip Booking Rate Plans
content:
Where a guest brings a Keyturn Trip Booking vehicle back later or earlier than the scheduled return, the figures that price the difference come from the reservation's rate plan. This schedule carries them for all six plans: the minutes past the scheduled return that are not charged, the price of each late hour beyond that grace, the late hours after which a whole extra day is charged instead, the ceiling on late-return charges for one day, whether returning early earns a credit, and the percentage of the unused reserved time credited back on an early return.

| Figure | Hourly | Daily | Weekend | Weekly | Monthly | Extended Stay |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Late-return grace (minutes) | 15 | 30 | 30 | 45 | 60 | 90 |
| Price of each late hour (USD) | 24.00 | 32.00 | 34.00 | 38.00 | 42.00 | 45.00 |
| Late hours at which a whole day is charged instead | 3 | 4 | 4 | 6 | 8 | 12 |
| Ceiling on late-return charges for one day (USD) | 165.00 | 220.00 | 240.00 | 275.00 | 320.00 | 360.00 |
| Early return earns a credit | yes | no | no | yes | yes | yes |
| Credit on unused reserved time (per cent) | 100 | 0 | 0 | 50 | 40 | 35 |

### Where the plans part company

The grace, the hourly price, the escalation point and the daily ceiling all rise with the length of the plan, from a grace of 15 minutes and an escalation at 3 late hours on the Keyturn Hourly Rate Plan to a grace of 90 minutes and an escalation at 12 late hours on the Keyturn Extended Stay Rate Plan.

Early returns divide the ladder rather than grade it. The Keyturn Daily Rate Plan and the Keyturn Weekend Rate Plan carry no early-return credit at all, and their credit percentage stands at 0. Of the four plans that do carry one, the Keyturn Hourly Rate Plan credits the whole of the unused reserved time at 100 per cent, while the Keyturn Weekly, Monthly and Extended Stay Rate Plans credit 50, 40 and 35 per cent of it.
